title: Reading Drill — Evaluating discounts at a cinema — Reviewing the evidence
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Evaluating discounts at a cinema — Reviewing the evidence
passages.body:
**A** The cinema manager in Brackenton received an old report about popular screenings still having empty seats after booking. The report compared the share of reservations used, but some entries had been collected under different conditions. To check the report, reviewers returned to the ticket scans rather than treating the published figures as a complete record.

**B** The review covered eight weeks. In the first part of that period, the original records did not consistently include last-minute film changes. In the later part, the recording sheet included a separate field for it. The reviewers kept readings from both periods, but marked which items were missing rather than guessing what had happened.

**C** The conclusion listed same-day reminders as a possible later response. It recommended collecting another set of readings before deciding whether to use it. The new data would be published with the method, so another group could work out whether its own measurements were comparable.
